title: Irminsul: MLA-Native Position-Independent Caching for Agentic LLM Serving
authors: Bole Ma; Jan Eitzinger; Harald Köstler
affiliations: Erlangen National High Performance Computing Center
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: Agentic workloads place bit-identical tokens at shifted positions every turn, voiding exact-prefix caches at the first byte of divergence (operators report TTFT spikes of 10–16s on unchanged content). Prior position-independent caching (PIC) systems must correct RoPE over the full d_K-dimensional key — an architectural cost imposed by GQA, since GQA fuses position inseparably into the K tensor.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic 工作負載在每一輪都把位元相同的 token 放到位移後的位置，使 exact-prefix cache 在第一個分歧位元組即失效（營運者回報未變更內容仍出現 10–16 秒的 TTFT 尖峰）。既有的 position-independent caching（PIC）系統必須對完整 d_K 維的 key 修正 RoPE——這是 GQA 將位置資訊與 K tensor 不可分離地融合所造成的架構性成本。

key_innovation.en: First MLA-native PIC system: MLA factors each KV row into a position-free 512-dim latent c_KV and a 64-dim RoPE key k_r correctable in closed form via a single δ-rotation. Irminsul extends SGLang's radix cache with content-hash keying over CDC-chunked segments (Gear-hash boundaries + xxHash64 fingerprints), a δ-rotation rule fuseable into FlashMLA, and a first-chunk carve-out that sidesteps the attention-sink regime.
key_innovation.zh: 第一個 MLA 原生的 PIC 系統：MLA 將每個 KV row 分解為與位置無關的 512 維 latent c_KV 與 64 維 RoPE key k_r，後者可藉單一 δ-rotation 以封閉形式修正。Irminsul 在 SGLang 的 radix cache 上加入以 content hash 為鍵的 CDC 分塊（Gear-hash 邊界 + xxHash64 指紋）、可融合進 FlashMLA 的 δ-rotation 規則，以及避開 attention-sink 區域的 first-chunk carve-out。

baselines_compared: SGLang (exact-prefix RadixAttention), Naive KV reuse, Fixed-block hashing

key_improvements.en: Recovers up to ~83% of prompt tokens above exact-prefix on agentic traffic (77.2% on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, 82.7% on JoyAI-48B for agent-metadata rotation); 63% prefill energy saving per MLA cache hit; δ-rotation error 4.7×10⁻³ rel-L2 in bf16; CDC+fallback finds 3.8–4.8× more reuse than fixed-block hashing offline.
key_improvements.zh: 在 agentic 流量上於 exact-prefix 之外額外回收最高約 83% 的 prompt token（agent-metadata rotation 下 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 為 77.2%、JoyAI-48B 為 82.7%）；每次 MLA cache hit 節省 63% 的 prefill 能耗；δ-rotation 誤差在 bf16 下為 4.7×10⁻³ rel-L2；離線分析中 CDC+fallback 找到的可重用量為 fixed-block hashing 的 3.8–4.8 倍。
